thread:
Priya (product): Heads-up 44 new ask from Acme: they'd like Elastic Lanes gated rollout next quarter but need deterministic latency guarantees + a documented rollback plan. We should map dependencies and decide a minimal acceptance bar so we don't over-index scope.
Leo (eng-runtime): Runtime view: we can hit steady-state p50/p95 targets pretty easily. p99 is trickier with cold-KV misses; we have a prototype prewarm that helps but increases memory. Need to know acceptable p99 for Acme (or a percentile+SLO budget).
Akemi (eng-infra): Infra note: to make KV prewarm feasible we need short-lived prewarmed instances and a custom warmup hook in the autoscaler. That changes cost profile. We'll need finance signoff for reserved burst capacity or a burst-for-pay plan.
Eleni (finance): Finance  curious on delta. Can infra provide a delta estimate: baseline ops cost vs prewarm+burst? A rough number will help decide whether we can underwrite initial pilot.
Jordan (security): Security input: Acme requires customer-managed keys for their private deployment and an attestation that key material never leaves HSM. We can certify hosted with KMS+VPC logs. Proposal: hosted GA first, private later after HSM procurement.
Maya (eng-platform): Platform: routing + per-tenant config are done. Missing: a rollback signal and an automated mitigation path (scale-to-zero fallback, model-fallback to smaller variant). We also need a short runbook for on-call.
Priya (product): Proposed minimal acceptance (pilot): 1) p95 <= 120ms and p99 <= 450ms under 10% synthetic spike; 2) 2-week automated regression run against canonical prompt set (no >1% quality regression); 3) autoscaler supports prewarm hooks and a documented cost delta; 4) KMS signoff for hosted or HSM plan for private. Thoughts?
Leo (eng-runtime): I like the two-week regression. For the p99 target, can we allow a temporary spike during cold starts if prewarm is documented? Maybe add: cold-start window exempt if prewarm not feasible for on-prem.
Akemi (eng-infra): We'll model cost delta and upload a spreadsheet by Tuesday. If we can't reserve capacity, propose a soft-limit pilot where we accept occasional throttling and alerting. Not ideal for SLAs but workable for limited pilots.
Jordan (security): Add 'attestation artifact' as an acceptance item for private: vendor HSM cert + signed audit log config. For hosted, we need KMS audit sample + rotation policy doc.
Maya (eng-platform): Rollback conditions: automatic rollback if error rate >1.5% for 3 min OR model quality regression >1% on canary prompts. Add an immediate manual override option in Console.
Priya (product): OK owners: Runtime=Leo, Infra=Akemi, Security=Jordan, Platform=Maya, Finance=Eleni. I'll coordinate with Acme and draft the external pilot SLA.
Leo (eng-runtime): Action: I'll land the KV prewarm hook PR and add the synthetic-driver tests. PR: http://git.internal/ri/elastic-lanes/kv-prewarm. ETA Tue EOD.
Akemi (eng-infra): Action: capacity-cost delta spreadsheet -> /docs/sheets/elastic-lanes-prewarm-costs.xlsx (will share link). ETA Tue noon.
Jordan (security): Action: I'll sketch attestation checklist + hosted-KMS audit sample. ETA Wed.
Maya (eng-platform): Action: canary rollback implementation + runbook snippets. I'll post runbook draft in #oncall by Wed EOD.
Eleni (finance): Action: I'll prepare a funding recommendation for a 3-month pilot (numbers pending Akemi).
Priya (product): Timeline: if all owners hit ETAs, we can start a gated pilot in the week of Apr 12 and decide expansion after a 2-week pilot. If anyone can't meet ETAs, flag now.
Leo (eng-runtime): All good for me.
Akemi (eng-infra): On it.
Jordan (security): OK.
Maya (eng-platform): OK.
Eleni (finance): Standby for numbers.
deploy-bot: Canary deployed to staging (build 2026.04.01.09). Checks: kv-prewarm=true, regression-run=scheduled, autoscaler=prewarm-hook-enabled.
